description: trellis：会话开始/压缩后提醒待处理事项和 memory，拦截项目内的删除命令

hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ] && python3 "$d/agent/tools/scripts/scan.py" "$d" --brief || true

d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ] && python3 "$d/agent/tools/scripts/scan.py" "$d" --brief --after-compact || true
d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/agent/trellis.json" ] && python3 "$d/agent/tools/scripts/guard_delete.py" --codex || true
